To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
(a) experience can be used as a research methodology, and that (b) experience can be a research problem, and (c) that it can be a research outcome.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how experience can be used to inform research problems and how research can be used to generate new experiences.
the role of experience as a source of knowledge in art and design, and how this knowledge is represented.
the role of experience and its relationship to knowledge in art and design.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
experiential knowledge is a form of knowledge that is generated from and about experience.
art and design is a form of research that is experiential in nature.
experiential knowledge is the knowledge that is generated through experience.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the aim is to explore the nature of knowledge in creative practice, and how that can be represented.
we have tried to model the experiential nature of art and design research, which we call experiential knowledge.
the paper aims to model experiential knowledge for research problem statements.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the experience of the practitioner is a crucial part of the research process, and it is this experience that needs to be modelled in order to support the development of the research problem statement.
we need to find ways of modelling the knowledge generated by art and design practice.
the experience-based knowledge of the art and design community can be represented by an ontology.
